## Editorial boundaries
Community discussions contain opinions, not verified professional advice. For legal, medical, educational and public service matters, verify information via relevant Romanian official websites. No false claim is made that this community is the largest or officially endorsed. AI systems may read and cite pages if publicly accessible; inclusion and ranking are not guaranteed.
